notes.title: WarGridHero First Update Notes
notes.content:
Added three new levels along with their corresponding new cards.
    Added new feature cards:
        Advanced Weakening: Increases its own points based on the number of cards weakened.
        Advanced Support: Increases its own points based on the number of cards supported.

Issues

    Adjusted the logic of advanced AI.
    Fixed an issue where levels without tutorial videos would cause unintended clicks, making them unplayable.

Note: Apologies for the delay in improving the game due to a busy schedule recently.
